intro: Tajikistan is an authoritarian presidential republic.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Emomali Rahmon has held power since 1992 and is called 'Leader of the Nation'. Opposition parties have been banned and elections are not seen as free.

chapters.title: Neighbours
text: Tajikistan borders Afghanistan along the Panj river, and Russia keeps a military base there.

keyTerms.meaning: A system with power concentrated in a few hands.
